validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED, high confidence. IGAT-9 (ninth Iran Gas Trunkline) is a real, major 56-inch gas transmission trunk carrying South Pars gas from Asaluyeh (Bushehr) to the Bazargan border crossing (West Azerbaijan) via Ahvaz/Dehgolan, with ~17 compressor stations. Independent, separate-origin sources: SHANA (Iran oil-ministry news, 2019-09-02) names IGAT-9, 56-inch, South Pars, Bazargan; Offshore-Energy (Dutch trade press, 2014) gives 110 mcm/d added capacity, 17 booster stations, Assaluyeh origin, NIGC operator; World Pipelines (2020) and DMS Projects independently list IGAT-9 at 56-inch. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION — CORRECT: gas transmission trunk (not gathering/process); FuelSource South Pars gas field confirmed (SHANA). DUPLICATE — NO. Superficially similar to P0441 (IGAT 11: also Asaluyeh->NW Azerbaijan, 56-inch, and IGAT 11's cap of '110' [mcm/d] equals IGAT 9's 3,885 MMcf/d, i.e. 110 mcm/d) but IGAT 9 and IGAT 11 are documented as distinct numbered trunklines in the IGAT series (NrgEdge/DMS list them separately); IGAT 9 = Asaluyeh->Bazargan, IGAT 11 = separate later line. Flag for awareness, not a merge. ATTRIBUTION — OK: Owner Iran Ministry of Petroleum (100%) is defensible (operator is its subsidiary NIGC per Offshore-Energy); endpoints Asaluyeh->Bazargan/West Azerbaijan confirmed. SPEC caveats: (1) LENGTH — sheet 1,900 km disagrees with the source consensus of 1,800 km (Offshore-Energy, TheIranProject, SHANA) / 1,863 km (Persian-language reporting); no independent source supports 1,900. (2) DIAMETER 56 in confirmed for the main line, but NW extensions (e.g. Ajabshir-Marand) are reported at 48/50 in per 2026 Persian reporting. (3) CAPACITY 3,885 MMcf/d is exactly 110 mcm/d (x35.31) and matches the universally cited 110-mcm/d design figure. (4) SEGMENTCOST — sheet records $8.9B (2014) but its own cited source theiranproject.com and Offshore-Energy both state $8.5B. (5) StartYear1=2022 is unverifiable: partial sections injected gas from 2019 and the full line is still incomplete in 2026, so no clean single 'start' year.

fills.researcher_notes: SHANA states IGAT-9 carries South Pars gas from Asaluyeh; Offshore-Energy independently gives the Assaluyeh (South Pars) origin. Verifier confirmed 'South Pars' on SHANA and 'Assaluyeh' on Offshore-Energy.
Endpoint pair Asaluyeh->Bazargan (West Azerbaijan) corroborated: verifier confirmed 'Bazargan' on SHANA and 'Assaluyeh' on Offshore-Energy; both trace the line to the northwest/Turkey border.

Existing Capacity [ref] (bncnetwork.net) fails value verification. The recorded 3,885 MMcf/d is exactly 110 mcm/d (110 x 35.3147 = 3,884.6); Offshore-Energy (verified '110') and multiple Persian sources give the 110-mcm/d design figure. Medium because the sources state the metric figure, not the MMcf/d number literally (unit-conversion match).

Cannot pair a ref to 1,900 km: no independent source supports it. Consensus is 1,800 km (Offshore-Energy, TheIranProject, SHANA) or 1,863 km (Persian reporting). Leaving unfilled rather than attach a source that disagrees with the recorded value; recommend correcting LengthKnown to the consensus.

StartYear1=2022 unverifiable. IGAT-9 is a multi-section, decade-long build: sections injected gas from 2019, and further sections were commissioned during 2024-2026 while the full line remains incomplete. No source ties operation start to 2022. Not fabricating a ref.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status stays 'construction'. Most recent independent evidence: Mizan (2026-02-08) reports that during the 14th government (mid-2024 on) ~1,038 km of gas transmission line was commissioned 'including significant sections of the ninth, seventh and first national trunklines' (نهم) — i.e. IGAT-9 is still being built out section-by-section, actively progressing, not fully operating and not shelved/cancelled. Persian reporting (2025-2026) describes continuing sections (e.g. Ajabshir-Marand ~260 km). Earlier SHANA (2019) documented ongoing pipe-laying to Bazargan. Active construction well within any dormancy threshold, so 'construction' is confirmed; no evidence the whole line is in commercial operation yet, so not 'operating'.

summary: P0448 IGAT 9 CONFIRMED real, correctly classified gas transmission trunk (Asaluyeh->Bazargan, 56-in, South Pars feed, ~110 mcm/d), not a duplicate of P0441 IGAT 11; status construction confirmed to 2026-02; caveats: length 1,900 km unsupported (consensus 1,800-1,863) and SegmentCost $8.9B disagrees with cited $8.5B.
